email_subject: Application - Shopper Marketing Intern at Danone
email_body:
Dear Danone Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the Shopper Marketing Internship at Danone in Brussels. With a background in digital marketing, SEO, and content creation, I am eager to bring my skills to your Shopper Marketing team and contribute to iconic brands like Alpro and Danette.

In my current role at Episto, I manage on-page SEO, create keyword-targeted content, and build WordPress sites for clients. My personal project, mirook.com, involved designing a multi-page site, implementing structured data, and running technical audits to improve search visibility. These experiences have honed my analytical and organizational skills, and I am excited to apply them to shopper activations and campaign performance analysis.

I am fluent in English and Turkish, with Dutch at B1 level (currently improving). I am passionate about consumer brands and eager to learn about the Belgian retail landscape. I am available for a 6-month internship starting between December 2026 and February 2027.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the opportunity to contribute to Danone's mission.

Best regards,
Baver Ok

Dear Danone Hiring Team,

I am excited to apply for the Shopper Marketing Internship at Danone in Brussels. As a junior digital marketer with a strong foundation in SEO, content creation, and web design, I am drawn to Danone's commitment to innovation and its iconic brands like Alpro and Danette. I am eager to contribute to shopper activations and learn from your experienced team.

In my current role at Episto, I manage on-page SEO, write keyword-targeted blog content, and build WordPress websites for clients. This has sharpened my analytical skills and attention to detail. These experiences have taught me to coordinate projects end-to-end, work with various tools, and measure performance against KPIs—skills directly applicable to shopper marketing.

I am particularly interested in the Belgian retail landscape and am eager to deepen my understanding of shopper behavior. My ability to work independently and adapt quickly, combined with my collaborative spirit, would allow me to support your team effectively. I am fluent in English and Turkish, with Dutch at B1 level, and I am actively improving my Dutch to better connect with local shoppers.

I am available for a 6-month internship starting between December 2026 and February 2027. I am passionate about consumer brands and excited to bring my energy and curiosity to Danone. Thank you for considering my application.

Sincerely,
